subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Hello team members! We are excited to announce that our annual team building event will take place next month on Friday, August 20th. This year, we will be hosting a fun day out at the local adventure park, with activities such as zip-lining, team challenges, and a BBQ lunch. Please mark your calendars and RSVP by the end of this week so we can finalize the arrangements. We look forward to seeing you all there!
